summary: Implemented show_speed for unknown-total progress tasks in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option and a render_speed classmethod, track() gained a show_speed parameter (default True), and Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total. Added a CHANGELOG entry and test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Nothing was run: tests, mypy and black were not executed, per the instructions, so all changes are verified by reading only. Changes are uncommitted.
